title: Samara Asset Group CEO: Bitcoin Treasury Companies a “Disservice to Shareholders”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Samara Asset Group CEO: Bitcoin Treasury Companies a “Disservice to Shareholders” Patrick Lowry argues 'digital gold' was flawed marketing, explaining why the market rejects pure treasury plays and how Samara deploys BTC as working capital. This post Samara Asset Group CEO: Bitcoin Treasury Companies a “Disservice to Shareholders” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
